player_intent: Browser players can practice solo and select weapons without waiting for 32 tournament players or a signaling service.
acceptance_rule: Training Grounds opens main.tscn in public training mode, clears stale network launch intent, provides the existing B loadout menu and shootable targets, and returns to the browser launcher. The restricted export contains main.tscn but no development labs.

nodes.role: Opens canonical solo training without multiplayer admission.

visual_check: Open the restricted Web build, click Training Grounds, check the player/reticle/dummies, press B near spawn to choose weapons, and return to the launcher. Do not count a desktop-only preview as browser verification.

system_delta.reason: Reuse existing public training rather than adding a second gameplay implementation; add browser navigation and explicit scene packaging.

current.system: Native-only training action excluded from browser navigation

candidate.system: Shared public training in both native and browser launchers
